messages:
sophie: quick idea — instead of the usual pricing calculator, what if we ship a tiny interactive 'slab simulator' that shows real monthly runs for three archetypes (prototype, scale, enterprise) and plugs into the inbound routing rules?

matt: love the idea. keeps it concrete. can we surface estimated token costs per use-case too?

ersin reply: (erin): yes pls. tokens + burst throughput note. helps sales and eng.

luke: micro-ask — how much copy real estate do we want? inline FAQ accordion or a guided modal?

sophie: leaning modal for the simulator, inline accordion for FAQ. modal has the calculator + CTA + radio for deployment (hosted / dedicated / private).

anya: for tier names: Prototype / Production / Enterprise sounds fine but we should test 'Startup / Growth / Enterprise' vs 'Prototype / Scale /Enterprise' in an A/B. small sample will show which converts better.

matt: agree on test. also add a toggle for "commit level" to surface monthly discount math.

marketing-bot: FYI — created a HubSpot form: https://app.hubspot.com/forms/12345/pricing-slab-sim

luke: routing rules proposal (GH flow):
```
if form.deployment == 'private' OR company.size > 500 => route to AE-enterprise
else if monthly_est >= 5k => route to SDR-enterprise
else => route to self-serve-nurture
```

sophie: can we add an "ops follow-up" tag if the user picks "dedicated" so eng-sre sees it?

matt: yes — add property `requires_oncall` when deployment == dedicated/private. then webhook to slack channel #sales-ops.

anya: QA checklist for launch: 1) copy final (3 variants) 2) calculator math verification (token math + discounts) 3) routing smoke test 4) GDPR cookie banner on modal 5) analytics events (simulate flows).

ersin reply: (erin): I'll own math verification. will write unit tests for the token calc.

luke: I'll mock the HubSpot form and run routing sims. need example payloads from product.

sophie: copy owners — @matt for CTAs, @anya for tier names, @erin for numbers. timeline: small spike this week, soft-launch behind feature flag Mon next week, measure 72h.

matt: can we instrument micro-MQL metric? conversion from simulator -> contact form -> AE meeting.

marketing-bot: added task checklist in Asana: https://app.asana.com/0/123456789/987654321

anya: quick UX note — show the "expected latency" row in the simulator when someone picks Dedicated. reduces surprises.

sophie: perfect. one more: write a 3-line benchmark blurb for the launch post that compares cost/latency for the three archetypes. short + visual. @matt take a pass?

matt: will draft. starting with: "Prototype: low cost, single-digit latency; Scale: balanced cost & latency; Enterprise: SLA-backed latency, dedicated capacity." will iterate copy to be less jargon.

sophie: great. last: A/B hypothesis for success: Variant A (Startup/Growth labels + inline FAQ) lifts contact rate by >=12% vs Variant B (Prototype/Scale + modal simulator). we aim to pick winner after 7 days.

luke: noted. tracking plan attached to Asana task.

anya: thumbs up 

matt: 👍 going to draft the experimental page now, will ping for quick reviews.

sophie: thanks everyone — small, measurable experiment. will follow up with the rollout plan and release flag details.
